sources.author: Hooman
patch_list: Unlocks Cronometer Gold without a subscription, like custom charts, advanced reports, the fasting tracker, custom biometrics, an ad-free view, and more. Anything Cronometer works out on its own servers still needs Gold.

sources.label: Dutch App
sources.author: Dutch App
patch_list: Stops Adjust SDK initialisation and event tracking.
Stops Google Mobile Ads initialisation and Cronometer's banner/interstitial load paths. No ad request is made; the Dart ad slots remain empty.
Disable ads, tracking and Gold upsells

Disables selected advertising and telemetry paths, unlocks local Gold controls, and hides Gold promotions, food suggestions, referrals and the persistent first-food tip. Server-backed features still require their native services.
Stops the Amplitude Flutter plugin's method channel before it records events or flags.
Stops Braze plugin attachment and automatic content-card, banner, feature-flag and push subscriptions.
Stops Datadog SDK initialisation (RUM, logs and native crash reports) while preserving Flutter channel replies.
Stops Firebase Analytics event, user-id and user-property writes from the Flutter plugin.
